title: Napole report v2
description: One tick's counts for one section (fromStepId -> toStepId) of one workflow. Field names are the external contract's, misspellings included. inputCount counts executions; the other three count step outcomes, with no deduplication, so they may add up to more than inputCount (e.g. two branches reaching toStepId add two).

insertionTime.description: When the report was built, epoch milliseconds.

timStampHour.description: UTC hour of reportFromTime as YYYYMMDDHH.

inputCount.description: Executions whose first fromStepId outcome is in the window and whose end is proven: they reached toStepId, or failed or were cancelled on the way.

outputCount.description: Completed outcomes at toStepId, one per arrival.

discardedCount.description: Cancelled outcomes: at toStepId for executions that reached it, otherwise on the way at or after their first fromStepId outcome (e.g. not on the whitelist).

failedCount.description: Failed outcomes: at toStepId for executions that reached it, otherwise on the way at or after their first fromStepId outcome.
